title: [finding] references/true-green.md carries no line-ratchet ceiling row — every sibling pm-dispatch references file does
body:
Filed unassigned by the wave-4-B protocol-text family dev (session `session_01RMTpSRF5CjMmQBFfPtPCwJ` dispatch, branch `claude/issue-11109-protocol-text-family`). Recording only.

The per-repo true-green index page `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/true-green.md` (added by the protocol-text family PR) has no row in the `CEILINGS` map of `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`. Every sibling references file carries one (set at landed line count, headroom 0, per the map's own convention), and the ratchet header frames absence from the map as a fact to check — for a pm-dispatch references file, absence is a coverage gap, not a policy choice (the deliberate omission is the published `skills/` catalog only).

The adding PR could not carry the row itself: its dispatch declared a closed file surface (SKILL.md + os-dev.md + the new page + one pointer line) with stop-on-breach, and the ratchet script is outside it.

Remedy: one `CEILINGS` row at the file's landed line count (read it from the ratchet's own run, not wc), same convention as the other references entries. Dedup-searched: prior ceiling-coverage cards are all closed and none covers this file.
